title: Art thou there, truepenny?
html_source:
Hamlet: Act 1 Scene 5..

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5-tYlYJ0PJM

Hamlet hears the ghost from the cellar and asks – ‘is that you ?’, truepenny meaning an honest man. The term derived from a valuable coin used in Shakespeare’s time.

We’ve already had Russell as formless spiritual and oracled out of his shadow and here Joyce satirises him as the ultimate non-material essence – a ghost.
